verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying the Windows build ships a native C++ + Vulkan engine. That implies a vendor-neutral GPU path that would not need ROCm, but nothing confirms AMD GPUs are supported or tested. missing for 10: explicit AMD GPU support statement, documentation that no ROCm install is required, Vulkan backend setup/usage docs, Vulkan on non-Windows platforms, performance benchmarks on AMD hardware, independent or hands-on corroboration.
